name: Sun Cleric: Sunwalker doubles Vow of Light's copied heal once, from 10% to 20%
contract: Sunwalker 704934 reads 'Dealing melee damage now generates a stack of Sunwalker. In addition, the value of Vow of
Light is doubled.' Its effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS, BasePoints 99 (+100%), on class
mask word 2 0x20000000, which only Vow of Light 807750 carries in family 33. Vow of Light 807547 heals the nearest
ally, a lone caster included, as 505197 for Amount(807750, 0, caster) percent of the effective direct healing received;
807750 effect 0 resolves to 10 and the caster argument applies the +100%. The script also multiplied that value by 2
for 704934, so the copy was 40% (batch 4, build f9da39a93c31). Two solo level-60 Sun Clerics heal themselves with
Greater Heal rank 11 (10965, 746-852 base); a received heal of at least 700 keeps integer truncation of the copy
within 0.0015 of the ratio. The copied heal ignores caster and health modifiers, so it never crits. The copy over the
effective heal must be 0.10 without Sunwalker and 0.20 with it (Sun Cleric ADR 0009).

steps.label: CONTROL: the control caster has no Sunwalker
SETUP: control Vow of Light is active
SETUP: Sunwalker Vow of Light is active
Let the global cooldown from Vow of Light clear
SETUP: the control heal is large enough to resolve the ratio
SETUP: the Sunwalker heal is large enough to resolve the ratio
CONTROL: without Sunwalker the copy is 10% of the healing received
DISCRIMINATING: Sunwalker doubles the copy once, to 20% of the healing received
